integrity: The proof rederives the bipartite auxiliary-graph bound and its equality case, excludes star centers, classifies supports through a complete three-layer geodesic test, and counts four disjoint structural cases. BFS-based direct subset enumeration and a separate leaf-position enumeration agree with every formula in their documented ranges.
scientific_limitations: Exact for paths of order at least two and stars with at least three leaves; the smaller-star cases are not claimed.
Counts maximum general-position sets, not all cardinalities, and treats labeled vertex subsets.
Direct finite verification covers the stated small ranges; the arbitrary-parameter result is analytically proved.
The primary path-factor theorem already provides the scalar maximum 2m, which is treated as prior coverage.
title: Exact census of maximum general-position sets in path–star strong products
